name: Bracers of Cu Chulainn
lore: Cu Chulainn, the Hound of Ulster, was Ireland's greatest warrior — a man who entered such battle frenzy that his body twisted and contorted, one eye bulging, his hair standing like spikes of flame. These bracers are stained with the blood of a hundred battles. They carry the warp-spasm's echo: the wearer strikes harder, bleeds enemies with every blow, and feels no pain from cuts.
curve_note: Template leather_bracers base_ac=1 + 0 (light leather, no AC stack from material). Power lives in the warp-spasm mechanics, not raw AC. F18-28 band sits between Asterion preparation (F20) and the mid-floor identity bands. The legacy 22 min_level was right; soft-curve peak at 28.
